insight: A little recent rain (4.4 mm) may be carrying some runoff to the shoreline — a modest upward pressure on bacteria. The model's main signals right now: 4.4 mm of rain has fallen, washing bacteria-laden runoff into the surf; limited sunlight is raising risk (less UV to disinfect the water); and high tide timing is lowering risk — how long before mid-morning the last high tide fell, which sets how much the water has just washed off the upper beach. The last lab sample (20 MPN/100mL) is now 17 days old — beaches are sampled about weekly, so a reading this stale carries little weight, and this estimate leans on current conditions.
